" type="video/mp4">你的浏览器不支持视频播放。</video></div>
        <div class="hero-visual-caption"><span class="live-dot"></span> 真实产品演示 <span class="hairline"></span> iPhone · Safari</div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-lower"><div class="scroll-cue"><span></span> 06 个章节，认识 Footprint Map</div><a href="#/origin" class="circular-arrow" aria-label="进入下一章">↘</a></div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="origin" aria-labelledby="origin-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">01 — DESIGN INTENT</div><h2 id="origin-title">为什么从一张地图开始？</h2><p>收藏的意义，不该停留在一个坐标。</p></div>
      <div class="origin-grid">
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 原版收藏星标与真实地图界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">01</span><h3>地点，是索引</h3><p>让想去与去过的地方，回到地图上的明确位置。</p></div></article>
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 真实地点内容与站外攻略界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">02</span><h3>内容，跟着地点走</h3><p>照片、视频、笔记、站外攻略，不再各自分散。</p></div></article>
        <article class="origin-card"><div class="origin-image"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Footprint Map 原版路线地图与连线界面" loading="lazy"></div><div class="origin-caption"><span class="mini-index">03</span><h3>收藏，也能成为出发</h3><p>把保存下来的地点串成路线，延续下一段旅程。</p></div></article>
      </div>
      <div class="statement"><span class="statement-star">★</span><p>从地点开始，让旅行信息重新连在一起。</p></div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="map" aria-labelledby="map-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">02 — MAP & ICONS</div><h2 id="map-title">地图的语言，已经在产品里。</h2><p>单颗黄星、轻量 POI、地图层级与路线连线，都来自现有产品。</p></div>
      <div class="map-stage">
        <div class="map-stage-photo"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="实际 iPhone 上的 Footprint Map 首页地图与黄色收藏星标" loading="lazy"></div>
        <div class="map-stage-notes">
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版收藏图标"/></span><div><strong>一颗黄星</strong><p>收藏是信息入口，不用重复的浮层和装饰抢占地图。</p></div></div>
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版地图适配图标"/></span><div><strong>地图优先</strong><p>搜索、选点、浏览与查看，尽可能留在同一张地图里。</p></div></div>
          <div class="note-row"><span class="key-icon"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="原版路线图标"/></span><div><strong>路线不离开地图</strong><p>路线点、连线和地理位置始终保持联系。</p></div></div>
          <div class="source-mark">本页示例：真实 V5 录屏 · 产品源文件 SVG</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="icon-block"><div class="icon-header"><div><span class="mini-index">ICON LIBRARY</span><h3>原版图标陈列</h3><p>原始 SVG 文件直接呈现，不重绘、不重新上色。</p></div><div class="icon-count"><strong>60</strong><span>个 SVG 素材<br>含 2 个状态变体</span></div></div>

      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">03 — VISUAL LANGUAGE</div><h2 id="system-title">视觉不只是一张好看的界面。</h2><p>卡片、控件、状态与间距，应该说同一种设计语言。</p></div>
      <div class="system-top">
        <div class="system-feature"><div class="feature-mosaic"><img src="data:image/webp;base64,
